payload.title: Monitor and review-rate program per output, not just the first classifier
payload.description:
The monitor says it is safe to step back, but only the first question is watched.

Current: review-program windows, gap check and version raises read only definition.classifiers[0] (embedded_cyclotron.py:527-545, :467-476). status() is per output (:797-805) with no rollup. Related in-progress work: flywheela8 (review rate as engine state).

Desired: per-output window evidence and rate changes, plus a cyclotron-level status showing the worst output.

Acceptance: when output 2 drifts and output 1 doesn't, the review rate rises and an event names output 2; status lists every output; existing single-output stores unchanged.
